trial_court: Principal Judge, Family Court, Tumakuru, M.C.No.119 of 2015
case_name: Smt. G.S.Rashmi vs Sri. Manjunath M S
facts_of_case: Marriage between parties was solemnized on 28.04.2011. Respondent filed petition seeking dissolution of marriage due to cruelty and desertion.

legal_principles.principle: Desertion means the intentional abandonment of the spouse by the other without consent and without a reasonable cause.
legal_principles.held: A Five Judge Bench of the Supreme Court in LACHMAN UTAMCHAND KIRIPALANI Vs. MEENA @ MOTA has held that desertion means the intentional abandonment of the spouse by the other without the consent of the other and without a reasonable cause.
cited_cases: LACHMAN UTAMCHAND KIRIPALANI Vs. MEENA @ MOTA

legal_principles.principle: In a petition seeking decree of divorce on the ground of cruelty, specific instances have to be pleaded and proved.
legal_principles.held: Similarly, in a petition seeking decree of divorce on the ground of cruelty, specific instances have to be pleaded and proved.

use_for_drafting: drafting divorce petition under Hindu Marriage Act
appealing family court judgment on divorce
advising client on grounds for divorce
